units.arcs: [fromLat, fromLon, toLat, toLon, share, km] per week
units.n: reports per cell, smoothed, clipped at the 99th percentile of the year

method: Each week normalised to a distribution, differenced against the next, and the cells that lost share matched nearest-first to the cells that gained it. Arcs are inferred journeys between places, not tracked birds; abundance is reports, so it carries observer effort with it.
